test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-II (Held On: 08 Jan, 2024)
subject: general
question:
Select the correct indirect form of the given sentence.

Ankit said to Ashna, “Do you know that the annual meeting has been postponed?”

options.text: Ankit asked Ashna that do you know that the annual meeting has been postponed.
Ankit asked Ashna if she had known that the annual meeting was postponed.
Ankit asked Ashna if she knew that the annual meeting had been postponed.
Ankit asked Ashna if she would be knowing that the annual meeting had been postponed.

solution:
The correct answer is Option 3)

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The direct speech sentence is a question and is converted into indirect speech by changing the question form to a statement form.
 
• The reporting verb '**said to'** is changed into **'asked'** because it is a question.
 
• The conjunction** 'if' **is used to connect the reported speech.
 
• The **tense** of the reported speech is changed from present perfect 'h**as been postponed'** to past perfect **'had been postponed'.**
 
• The pronoun **'you**' is changed to '**she**' to match the subject Ashna.

Thus, the correct indirect format is: **Ankit asked Ashna if she knew that the annual meeting had been postponed.**
